DEFAULT._description: Zensar 7-Bucket Debtors Aging Report — OU specific export
DEFAULT.notes: Aging report contains OPEN/PENDING invoices only — closed/paid invoices are never present in this export. invoice_number is NOT globally unique; uniqueness key is (invoice_number, ou_number). NEGATIVE outstanding_amount rows are credits, not debts — see aging_map.py's is_payable() and the credit-memo pool. INV DESC is populated on every credit memo and blank on every unapplied receipt, which is how the two are told apart.
DEFAULT._invoice_amount_note: The key here was 'INV AMT ' with a trailing space until 2026-08. parse_aging_file() strips column names, so the lookup never matched and every invoice_amount in the system was 0.0. Do not reintroduce the space.
